recommendation.quantity: d = (whole-body CoM - midpoint of the r_foot / l_foot sites) . l, l = the heading-frame left axis (z x the horizontal projection of the pelvis x axis); CoM = data.subtree_com[pelvis] (the pelvis subtree is the whole animal; the prey is a separate mocap body). mm, + = left.
recommendation.form: bonus: r_lean = w * exp(-(d / sigma)^2)  (cost vs d = 0: w * (1 - exp(-(d/sigma)^2)); bounded in [0, w])
recommendation.weight_note: w_budget = 2 / (mean statue window cost at w = 1) = 0.2885; 0.25 rounds down for margin (statue mean 1.73/episode). The failed CoP screen arm used a bonus of the same size (experiment_cop_weight 0.28, also active only after the 200-step settle).
recommendation.gate: active only for _step_count > stance_width_settle_steps (200: array steps 200-999, the gate's window), only while the command is zero, only while both feet carry foot_terms_min_support_force (168 N, substep MIN); weight set in stance.toml only (see gating)

statue_cost_per_episode.definition: sum over the episode of w (1 - exp(-(d_t/sigma)^2)), d = 0 being the reference; 39 full-horizon panel spawns (3081 falls at step 292)

statue_return_shift.note: a bonus adds about w x 800 to every standing episode's return: stance.toml's collapse_peak_floor_reference (3756.8, the statue's standing reward) must be re-measured with the term on

versus_existing_terms.earlier_ablation: foot/roll_diag: removing the lean (hip-roll common mode) changed the return by -1.2 (median over 15 failures): the existing reward does not price the lean at the margin

existing_terms.overlap: none: references the spawn, not the feet; a 15 mm lean costs 0.3 x 0.0075^2 = 1.7e-5 per step

existing_terms.touches: crab-walk velocity (locomotion 0.1, hunting behavior 0.3; BehaviorEnv zeroes it)

existing_terms.formula: -w (tilt / 1.047 rad)^2, tilt = pelvis up-axis vs vertical
existing_terms.overlap: none in practice: the lean is a translation; pelvis roll stays within 0.2 deg (foot/roll_diag)

existing_terms.formula: forward pitch beyond the natural lean
w cos(heading error to the prey direction)
-w |r - l| / (r + l) on substep-MIN touch; -0.3 more when total < 42 N

existing_terms.overlap: partial and weak: measured share slope 0.0018 /mm (statics 2/W = 0.0072 /mm; the pad CoPs move within the rolling pads), i.e. 0.0076 per step at 14 mm
none at these offsets: saturated (quiet support ~421 N per foot)

existing_terms.overlap: prices the symptom, not the cause; it is the bulk of the existing roll-rail gap and did not stop the lean

gate_rails.stance_quality/v2 (gate, not reward): max_sole_tilt_deg 2.0, max_sole_corner_lift_m 0.004 (the roll rail), max_sole_cop_fore_aft 0.8, min_foot_load_share 0.40, min_foot_load_share_windowed 0.35, max_window_displacement_m 0.10, max_settle_stance_width_change_m 0.08

where_commands_and_weights_come_from.stance: configs/.../stance.toml [env]; command_mode not set -> 'none' (BaseDinoEnv): self._command is constant zero, no command RNG draw
where_commands_and_weights_come_from.recovery: recovery.toml `extends = {stage = 'stance', tables = ['stage','env','ppo']}`: inherits every stance [env] key it does not write out (it writes foot_contact_* and stance_width_settle_steps = 140); command 'none'; pushes mid-episode
where_commands_and_weights_come_from.locomotion: locomotion.toml does NOT extend stance: keys it omits take the env class defaults; command_mode 'none', i.e. the command is ALSO zero while the animal walks toward the prey
where_commands_and_weights_come_from.behaviors: train_behaviors.read_recipe builds env_kwargs from locomotion.toml's [env] plus the recipe's; BehaviorEnv runs command_mode 'heading_and_speed' and zeroes a list of stationary objectives (drift, speed, idle, lateral, heading, ...); a stop (stop_probability, follow_direction_speed 0.15) sets the physical command to exactly (0, 0, 0)

gating.consequence: a command-zero test alone does NOT separate standing from locomotion (both 'none'); the primary gate must be the weight, which only stance.toml sets

proposal.recovery.toml: write lateral_lean_weight = 0.0 out explicitly (a push must be allowed to move the CoM, and a recovery step moves the foot midpoint), as recovery already writes stance_width_settle_steps; inheriting it instead would change recovery's task and need collapse_peak_floor_reference (1329.1) re-measured
proposal.locomotion.toml / behaviors: nothing: the class default 0.0 applies; add 'lateral_lean_weight' to BehaviorEnv's zeroed stationary-objective list so a behavior can never inherit it
proposal.code (TyrannosaurusRexEnv._get_reward_in:
lean_active = (self.lateral_lean_weight > 0.0 and self._step_count > self.stance_width_settle_steps and not np.any(self._command) and (self.foot_terms_min_support_force <= 0.0 or all(feet_supported)))
com = self.data.subtree_com[self.pelvis_id]; mid = 0.5 * (site_xpos[r_foot] + site_xpos[l_foot])
fwd = _quat_to_forward_2d(qpos[3:7]); left = (-fwd[1], fwd[0])
lateral_lean = float((com[:2] - mid[:2]) @ left)
reward_lateral_lean = self.lateral_lean_weight * exp(-(lateral_lean / self.lateral_lean_tolerance_m)**2) if lean_active else 0.0
info['lateral_lean'] = lateral_lean; info['reward_lateral_lean'] = reward_lateral_lean; added to the total only when lateral_lean_weight > 0 (like floor_impact), so the legacy sum keeps its order
proposal.why_after_the_settle: the reset alone puts the statue's CoM 12.4 mm (median; p90 24, max 34) off the foot midpoint at spawn, i.e. at the failing offsets; it decays to 1.3 mm by step 200 and 0.1 mm by step 600. Active from step 0 the term charges the statue 47.8/episode at w = 1 (vs 6.9 after the settle), so the <= 2 budget allows only w = 0.042: 0.024 per step at 14 mm, the size of the existing terms that already fail to stop the lean. After the settle it is the gate's own window and the stance_width convention
proposal.command_clause: always true in stance (command_mode 'none'); keeps the term off whenever a nonzero command is issued if a later behavior enables it; mirror invariant ((v_x, v_y, yaw) -> (v_x, -v_y, -yaw) keeps 'all zero')
proposal.support_clause: both feet above foot_terms_min_support_force (168 N, the substep MIN the flatness and width terms use): the foot midpoint is a support reference only while both feet carry load, and an airborne or one-legged step earns no bonus
proposal.time_clause_caveat: the step count is not observed (obs has no time), the same as stance_width's settled reference; d itself is a function of the observation (joint qpos incl. passive toes + projected gravity; the heading frame removes yaw)
proposal.fingerprint: new env kwargs and a stance.toml edit change the task fingerprint; stance collapse_peak_floor_reference 3756.8 must be re-measured (the bonus pays the statue about 199.6 per episode)

mirror_invariance.definition: d(M s) = -d(s) for the sagittal mirror M (root y -> -y, quat (w,x,y,z) -> (w,-x,y,-z), r_* <-> l_*, x/z-axis hinges negated, y-axis hinges kept); the term uses d only through (d/sigma)^2
mirror_invariance.gate_invariance: step count, 'command all zero' and 'both feet supported' are each mirror invariant
mirror_invariance.verdict: the term is exactly mirror invariant (the model's bodies and sites mirror to 0.0 m; d flips to 1.5e-13 mm)

verification.what: every stored roll_diag array (roll, pitch, tilt, lift, cop, contacts, leg_floor, qpos, ctrl, cmd, raw, root_pos, root_quat, foot_pos, reward, length, spawn_*) equal with NaN positions; authority_hr 6M and the statue on all 40 panel spawns, authority 6M and control 3M on the 19 foot/roll_diag spawns (the only stored arrays); all 400 base episodes match the judge rows
